fusions.name: Slid Through the Palms
fusions.desc: You let the staff run through your hands to jab an enemy up to 5 tiles away. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at the far end of its reach.

fusions.name: Silver Darts
fusions.desc: You flick the wet tip of the staff three times, sending 3 darts of water in a fan out to 6 tiles. Each deals 10 damage, knocks the enemy 2.5 tiles back and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Wet Grip Turn
fusions.desc: You spin the staff in a slick blur. For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 40% chance to slide off the haft and land on whoever laid it instead.

fusions.name: Slithers Down the Haft
fusions.desc: Your guard with the staff gives you +5% dodge chance. When a blow that is not fire lands on you, it slides down the haft and you restore 8 stamina, once every 8 seconds.
